_what: 전구간정상 G3 under the DECLARED window — the gate the window change bites hardest. Under the fallback the row immediately before this gate was 오세라 saying nobody is getting out, i.e. the default had ALREADY failed before the agent was asked to choose it; PR #214 moved that pair to 21:50 to repair it, by hand, one row at a time. The declared window states the repair instead of arranging it: the last thing the 요원 reads is the 21:22 broadcast it is being asked to follow up on, and the escalation rows (21:33 연쇄 발화 · 21:38 연기 전선) are simply not in the window. Two keys hang off one clause set here, so this suite also re-checks that k3 and k4 open different doors.

authoring_choices: TIMELINE_EXCERPT is G3's declared `excerpt` (t5 · t10 · t11 · t12) resolved on an EMPTY-handover run. t11 and t12 are the 21:22 broadcast's two versions and are mutually exclusive (`not pallet_named` / `pallet_named`); with no intervention at G2 the first shows and the second drops, so the window is three rows ending on 「차량 안에서 대기하십시오」. A run that named the pallet reads the OTHER broadcast at this same gate, which is the property that made the conditions worth keeping.

t14 (21:33 연쇄 발화) and t15 (21:38 연기 전선) are excluded on 규칙 6 grounds — both tell the 요원 the standing instruction has already failed. W5 also flags them, but by way of a false positive (k3's mined_from names the 주관 보고서 paragraph about 21:33, not the timeline row), so the exclusion rests on the authoring judgment, not on the lint.

Two live arms, one per key. k3 is 자기서술 aimed at 요원 자신 (cl2, 선행) and should open `b` 전면 대피 지시; k4 is 사실 aimed at 피난연결통로 and should open `c` 통로 위임. PR #214 saw 4 of 6 each way and read it as evidence that E-K1 holds in behaviour and not only on paper. Both arms vary BLOCKS only, which is what channel C-BLOCK permits.
Everything outside the window and the blocks is byte-identical to the G1 and G2 suites.

pre_registration.hypothesis: At G3 on the declared window, an empty handover takes the default stance `a` (지침 유지) in a clear majority of kept calls — the window now ends on the broadcast the default repeats rather than on its failure. A k3 sentence moves the modal stance to `b`, a k4 sentence to `c`, and the two do not move it to the same place.
pre_registration.drop_condition: If the baseline modal stance is not `a`, the 규칙 6 repair did not survive being stated declaratively and the excerpt is the suspect — the escalation rows are already out, so the next candidates are t10 and t5 (both stakes rows, and PR #214 measured that raising stakes strengthens the argument AWAY from the default). If k3 and k4 move the modal stance to the SAME stance, E-K1 does not hold in behaviour at this gate and the two conditions are not separable; that is a finding about the pack, not about the window.
contingencies: The baseline arm reads a window whose last row is 21:22 while the gate stands at 21:47 — twenty-five minutes in which the 요원 is told nothing. If departures cite the silence itself ('상황을 모른다') rather than any row, the finding is that a declared window can be too thin, and the fix is one more row, not a different rule.
k3 is 자기서술: the sentence speaks as the 요원 about its own earlier restraint. If it is read as a third-party report instead, that is a species failure worth recording against W3, not a window result.
Fabricated because_block_ids in the baseline arm are expected and are not discards.
pre_registration.not_claimed: No placebo arm here either. Nothing in this suite speaks to the tally: the crowd ladder moves on `pallet_named`, which is G2's flag, so a first run that leaves it unset carries the same number whichever stance G3 takes.
